scope: Selected reproduced records and report translations; not independently authenticated original manuscripts

records.year_month_context: Genroku 12, month 12, supplied by report context
records.translated_content: Villagers flee to hills; waves destroy 13 houses and a fire burns 20; rice provided to 159 persons and wood sought for shelters.
records.modern_time_interpretation: Around midnight January 27-28, 1700 Gregorian; report interpretation

records.record: Moriai-ke Nikki kakitome cho, Tsugaruishi account
records.correction_basis_reported: Similar fire report and adjacent snowstorm entry also dated one month earlier than snow reports in Morioka and Hachinohe records.
records.dependence: Kuwagasaki fire is hearsay in this account, not a second direct observation of that fire.
records.reported_absence: Account says no earthquake occurred locally; not a global absence of earthquake.

calendar_check.note: Executed Gregorian date addition using source anchor and month length; tests arithmetic only. Genroku 12 has intercalary ninth month in the report.

earthquake_time_inference.uncertainty: Report allows an earlier earthquake if reported flooding lagged the leading wave by one to two hours; no new confidence interval computed.
earthquake_time_inference.other_document_ambiguity: Report notes Tanabe dawn-of-eighth wording can mean start of eighth or be interpreted as ninth for agreement; Tanabe original passage not independently inspected in this tranche.
